Routine handover rules for the welfare crew
A busy shift shows why careful routines matter

This page covers daily handover for the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways, and it matters because each file, crate note, and carrier check affects a live animal in our care. New staff should start by reading the desk ledger, then confirm the booking record, the carrier label, and any service changes noted by the senior coordinator. Keep language clear and brief when passing work to the next shift, and write only what another agent needs to act without delay.

When a passenger asks about travel steps, answer in plain terms and keep the record aligned with the current plan. If the traveler brings a bird, check the health certificate and note its status before the file moves onward. <<FACT F083>> For reptile bookings, confirm the age rule before any acceptance is marked in the ledger. <<FACT F078>> For large dog cases, review the carrier and the combined load limit with care. <<FACT F063>>

If a pet shows stress, delay the handover until the passenger coordinator has reviewed the file and any special handling note is clear. Mark feeding, water, cleaning, and transfer details in the ledger at once, since delayed notes lead to missed steps. Keep the tone calm at the counter, and make sure each outgoing record is complete, legible, and easy to follow.

Remember to check the file, record the change, and pass on only what the next agent needs.
